summary: This batch reports two full building collapses at 105 Miles Ct (5 trapped) and 840 California St (7 trapped), alongside extensive structural damage at 500 Sansome St and 590 Bush St (1 trapped). Additional reports detail a building fire on Waverly Pl, blocked roads at Brooklyn Pl/Stockton St and Sansome/California St, and moderate facade/wall damage at 456 Montgomery St, 341 Sutter St, and 723 Vallejo St.
